transactions.desc: The Dodgers recalled Sheehan from Triple-A Oklahoma City, and manager Dave Roberts said the right-hander is scheduled to pitch behind opener Jack Dreyer against the Giants on Sunday, David Vassegh of AM 570 LA Sports reports.
The Rangers recalled Santos from Triple-A Round Rock on Sunday, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.
The White Sox optioned Murphy to Triple-A Charlotte on Sunday.
The White Sox activated Brazoban (lat) from the 15-day injured list Sunday.
Boston optioned Olds to Triple-A Worcester on Sunday.
The Red Sox activated Guerrero (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Sunday, per Ian Browne of MLB.com.
Cincinnati designated Friedl for assignment Sunday.
Cincinnati promoted Spiers from Triple-A Louisville on Sunday.
Tampa Bay designated Fraley for assignment Sunday.
Tampa Bay reinstated Williamson (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Sunday.
Philadelphia recalled Lazar from Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Sunday.
Hentges (forearm) was activated from the 15-day injured list Saturday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Astros recalled VanWey from Triple-A Sugar Land on Saturday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Rangers recalled Macko from Triple-A Round Rock on Saturday.
The Rockies optioned Hughes to Triple-A Albuquerque on Saturday.
The Royals recalled Bivens from Triple-A Omaha on Saturday.
The Astros designated Barrosa for assignment Saturday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Astros reinstated Matthews (knee) from the 60-day injured list Saturday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Reds optioned Friedl to Triple-A Louisville on Saturday.
The Reds optioned Aguiar to Triple-A Louisville on Saturday.
Cabrera joined the Reds' active roster Saturday.
The Reds recalled McCambley from Triple-A Louisville on Saturday.
The Mets recalled Mauricio from Triple-A Syracuse on Friday.
The Mets reinstated Perez (forearm) from the injured list Saturday.
The Mets optioned Weston to Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Orioles optioned Povich to Triple-A Norfolk on Saturday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
The Orioles reinstated Bautista (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Saturday, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
The Yankees recalled Schuemann from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Saturday.
The Orioles reinstated Franklin (hand) from the injured list Saturday, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
The Orioles optioned Kjerstad to Triple-A Norfolk on Saturday, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
